messages:
sam: Heads up — seeing a p99 tail in request-router for prod us-west starting ~08:12 UTC. I opened a small hotpatch PR that tightens the backoff and reduces max concurrent dialers. Would appreciate 1-2 reviews + a canary merge in the next 10m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821 :rotating_light:

maria-r: on it. can you include the cherry-pick + rollback steps? also what's the canary traffic target? :eyes:

sam: Canary plan: 10% traffic in us-west for 15m, watching p99/p95 and 5xx. Cherry-pick + deploy commands below:

```
# from maint branch
git fetch origin
git checkout -b hotfix/p99-2026-03-17
git cherry-pick 7d3f2a1
git push origin hotfix/p99-2026-03-17
# create PR -> merge to main
# deploy
infra-deploy --env prod --region us-west --service request-router --image hotfix-7d3f2a1
```

Rollback (if needed):
```
# revert the merge commit on main
git revert -m 1 <merge-sha>
git push origin main
infra-deploy --env prod --region us-west --service request-router --image <previous-image>
```

kevin: quick skim — change looks fine, only nit: backoff default is 50ms, maybe increase to 100ms to avoid thundering herd if downstream hiccups. otherwise +1 for the hotfix flow.

sam: good call, pushed update to PR (changed to 100ms). thx.

alex_m: I can take the merge if you want me to coordinate the canary window. I'll merge and kick canary once kevin or maria approve.

oncall-bot: Deployment scheduled: request-router (prod us-west) -> canary start at 1832103900, traffic=10%, duration=900s. Monitoring hooks: https://play.redwood-inference/mon/dashboards/request-router/us-west

maria-r: watching dashboards now. will alert on p95/p99 regressions or >0.5% 5xx increase. Have logs pinned to the trace stream.

sam: merged PR to main and tagged hotfix-7d3f2a1. canary started. pinging SRE channel for extra eyeballs. :thumbsup:

kevin: LGTM, approving now. :white_check_mark:

alex_m: Saw a small bump in p95 for ~30s right after deploy but it's back to baseline. continuing to watch for another 5m. If all good, I'll rollout to 100% at +20m.

ops-bot: Rollout note: canary completed with no critical alerts. Suggested next-step: gradual increase to 50% for 10m then full.

maria-r: 5m remaining on canary window, no 5xx increase. ok to scale to 50% when ready.

sam: thanks all — I'll stay on-watch for 30m then close the incident if stable. If anything spikes, revert plan is ready and I can run the revert steps. :pray:
